crew.overview: In a small town in Maine, seven children known as The Losers Club come face to face with life problems, bullies and a monster that takes the shape of a clown called Pennywise.
crew.title: It

crew.overview: Powered with incredible speed, Sonic The Hedgehog embraces his new home on Earth. That is, until Sonic sparks the attention of super-uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik. Now it’s super-villain vs. super-sonic in an all-out race across the globe to stop Robotnik from using Sonic’s unique power for world domination.
crew.title: Sonic the Hedgehog

details.biography:
Originally from Australia, Tim Cody is an accomplished stunt performer and stunt coordinator with a dynamic background in the performing arts. Beginning his career as a professional dancer, singer, and actor, Tim performed internationally with prestigious companies including Princess Cruises, Universal Studios Japan, and Warner Bros. Movie World. He was a cast member of the original international cast of the hit musical We Will Rock You, which premiered in Melbourne to record-breaking success before touring Australia and Japan for over two years.

Transitioning into film and television, Tim established himself in Toronto, Canada as a highly respected stunt professional, gaining extensive experience across a wide range of productions. Now based on the Gold Coast, Australia, Tim continues to work in the global screen industry, bringing a wealth of creative energy, precision, and leadership to every project he joins.

Tim is also a proud husband to Melissa Cody and father to three incredible children-Caleb, Declan, and Kirra-who remain his greatest inspiration.
details.name: Tim Cody
